He has appeared in a [[National Basketball Association]] game for the [[2023–24 Toronto Raptors season|2023–24 Toronto Raptors]]. He played college basketball for the [[Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball|Kansas State Wildcats]], and previously the [[Little Rock Trojans men's basketball|Little Rock Trojans]]. In high school he played at [[St. Anthony High School (New Jersey)|St. Anthony High School]], [[Bishop Loughlin Memorial High School]] and [[The Patrick School]]. In 2020, he was first-team All-[[Sun Belt Conference|Sun Belt]]. He holds the [[NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|Division I NCAA Tournament]] single-game [[Assist (basketball)|assists]] record, with 19 vs. [[2022–23 Michigan State Spartans men's basketball team|Michigan State]] in the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2023]] Sweet Sixteen. He won the 2023 [[Bob Cousy Award]]. In 2023, he was first-team All-[[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] and was a third-team [[2023 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2023 NCAA Men's Basketball All-American]]. ==High school career== Nowell began his high school career at [[St. Anthony High School (New Jersey)|St. Anthony High School]] in [[Jersey City, New Jersey]], under Hall Of Fame Coach [[Bob Hurley Sr.]] After receiving minimum playing time after his freshman year he decided to transfer schools to [[Bishop Loughlin Memorial High School]] for his sophomore and junior year, playing alongside [[Julian Champagnie|Julian]] and [[Justin Champagnie]]. Nowell averaged 19.9 points and 8.1 assists per game as a junior.{{cite news |title=RELEASE: Weber Announces the Addition of Transfer Markquis Nowell |url=https://kansasstate.rivals.com/news/release-weber-announces-the-addition-of-transfer-markquis-nowell/printable |access-date=February 25, 2023 |work=[[Rivals.com]] |date=April 1, 2021}} He transferred to [[The Patrick School]] for his senior season and averaged 10.9 points per game despite missing a month with injuries.{{cite news |last1=Green |first1=Arne |title=Kansas State basketball adds Little Rock transfer point guard Markquis Nowell |url=https://www.salina.com/story/sports/2021/04/01/kansas-state-basketball-adds-former-little-rock-point-guard-nowell/4847499001/ |access-date=February 25, 2023 |work=[[Salina Journal]] |date=April 1, 2021}} He received no Division 1 offers out of high school before getting a look from [[Little Rock Trojans men's basketball|Little Rock]].{{cite news |last1=Sweeney |first1=Kevin |title=Markquis Nowell Has Put Kansas State—and Himself—on the Map |url=https://www.si.com/college/2023/01/11/kansas-state-basketball-markquis-nowell-jerome-tang |access-date=February 25, 2023 |work=[[Sports Illustrated]] |date=January 11, 2023}} ==College career== As a freshman, Nowell averaged 11.1 points, 4.2 assists, 3.2 rebounds and 1.4 steals per game. He averaged 17.2 points, 4.9 assists, and 3.0 rebounds per game as a sophomore. Nowell was named to the First Team All-[[Sun Belt Conference|Sun Belt]].{{cite news |last1=Stoia |first1=George |title=Trojans' experience paying off |url=https://www.nwaonline.com/news/2020/oct/18/trojans-experience-paying-off/ |access-date=February 25, 2023 |work=[[Northwest Arkansas Democrat Gazette]] |date=October 18, 2020}} He was suspended for two games in January 2020 due to disciplinary reasons.{{cite news |last1=Lederman |first1=Eli |title=Nowell no longer a Trojan |url=https://www.arkansasonline.com/news/2021/feb/10/nowell-no-longer-a-trojan/ |access-date=February 25, 2023 |work=[[Arkansas Democrat-Gazette]] |date=February 10, 2020}} As a junior, Nowell averaged 14.3 points, 6.0 assists, 3.9 rebounds and 2.3 steals per game but opted out of the season in February 2020. Following the season, he transferred to [[Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball|Kansas State]]. Nowell averaged 12.4 points and team-highs of 5.0 assists and 2.2 steals per game in the 2021–22 season. He was one of two players to return to Kansas State after [[Jerome Tang]] was hired as coach to replace [[Bruce Weber (basketball)|Bruce Weber]].{{cite news |last1=Green |first1=Arne |title=Point guard Markquis Nowell has helped lead Kansas State to blazing start in the Big 12 |url=https://www.cjonline.com/story/sports/college/cat-zone/2023/01/06/kansas-state-mens-basketball-guard-markquis-nowell-off-to-fast-start/69780530007/ |access-date=February 25, 2023 |work=[[Topeka Capital-Journal]] |date=January 6, 2023}} On January 10, 2023, Nowell was named [[Oscar Robertson]] National Player of the Week by the U.S. Basketball Writers Association after scoring a career-high 36 points to go with nine assists and three steals in a 116–103 win against [[Texas Longhorns men's basketball|Texas]].{{cite web |title=K-State's Nowell Named Oscar Robertson National Player of the Week |url=https://big12sports.com/news/2023/1/10/mens-basketball-k-states-nowell-named-oscar-robertson-national-player-of-the-week.aspx |website=[[Big 12 Conference]] |access-date=February 25, 2023 |date=January 10, 2023}} He was named to the First Team All-[[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] as well as the All-Defensive Team.{{cite web |title=K-State's Tang Big 12 Coach of the Year, Johnson & Nowell 1st team |url=https://kansasstate.rivals.com/news/k-state-s-tang-big-12-coach-of-the-year-johnson-nowell-1st-team?guccounter=1&guce_referrer=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZ29vZ2xlLmNvbS8&guce_referrer_sig=AQAAAGamiWj95_z5oCR21jtLz9zxHapO2tPyCJ8KWle5p6q29z1vZI-E-8tRKiCjvxNBVqSSCtaK5oxsHPCTyypuu4Nww0nG9aDbvKm3jx6GY6byBan9X6A6zg00Wung0Z1BzKBA9lT9JJy13qWaLBA5uExkUTppEM21ve5dza2zHRsT |website=[[Rivals.com]] |access-date=March 6, 2023 |date=March 5, 2023}} During the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], Nowell scored 17 points and recorded a then career-high 14 assists during a 77–65 first round win over [[2022–23 Montana State Bobcats men's basketball team|Montana State]].[https://www.kstatesports.com/news/2023/3/17/mens-basketball-15-13-k-state-vs-montana-state Hot Shooting Propels 15/13 K-State Past Montana State, 77-65] On March 19, Nowell scored 27 points and dished out 9 assists in a Second Round win over the [[2022–23 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky Wildcats]].[https://www.si.com/college/kentucky/.amp/mbb/markquis-nowell-kansas-state-ends-kentucky-ncaa-tournament-run-75-69-thriller] On March 23, during a Sweet 16 matchup against Michigan State, while playing with a sprained ankle, along with 20 points and 5 steals, Nowell recorded 19 assists in an overtime win, setting a new NCAA Tournament record for assists in a single game. He also battled an ankle injury during the [[2022–23 Michigan State Spartans men's basketball team|Michigan State]] game.[https://sports.yahoo.com/march-madness-kansas-states-markquis-nowell-sets-ncaa-tourney-record-for-assists-in-ot-win-over-michigan-state-010210606.html] On March 25, Nowell scored 30 points and 12 assists in a losing effort against [[2022–23 Florida Atlantic Owls men's basketball team|Florida Atlantic]] in the Elite 8 of the NCAA Tournament.{{cite news |last1=Owens |first1=Jason |title=March Madness: Florida Atlantic survives Markquis Nowell, Kansas State in thriller for 1st Final Four berth |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/march-madness-florida-atlantic-survives-markquis-nowell-kansas-state-in-thriller-for-1st-final-four-berth-003241039.html |access-date=March 28, 2023 |work=[[Yahoo Sports]] |date=March 25, 2023}} During the tournament, he averaged 23.5 points, 13.5 assists and 4.0 steals, and his 54 single-tournament assist total was the third highest in tournament history and the most since [[Rumeal Robinson]] posted 56 34 years earlier. He earned Most Outstanding Player honors for the NCAA East Regional. Following the season, he won the [[Bob Cousy Award]].{{cite web|url=https://www.kstatesports.com/news/2023/3/31/mens-basketball-nowell-wins-bob-cousy-award|title=Nowell Wins Bob Cousy Award|accessdate=July 10, 2026|date=April 1, 2023|publisher=[[Kansas State University]]}} ==Professional career== ===Toronto Raptors / Raptors 905 (2023–2024)=== After going undrafted in the [[2023 NBA draft]], Nowell signed a two-way contract with the [[Toronto Raptors]] on July 3, 2023.{{cite web|title=RAPTORS SIGN NOWELL TO A TWO-WAY CONTRACT|url=https://www.nba.com/raptors/news/raptors-sign-nowell-to-a-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=July 3, 2023|access-date=July 4, 2023}} On July 15, he recorded 17 points, 12 assists and 3 rebounds in a 108–101 summer league win against the [[Golden State Warriors]].{{cite web|title=Warriors 101-108 Raptors (July 15, 2023) Box Score -ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/nba-summer-league/boxscore/_/gameId/401558293/league/nba-summer-las-vegas|website=ESPN.com|access-date=July 16, 2023}} On March 4, 2024, he was waived by Toronto{{cite web|title=RAPTORS SIGN GUEYE TO TWO-WAY CONTRACT|url=https://www.nba.com/raptors/news/raptors-sign-gueye-to-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=March 4, 2024|access-date=March 4, 2024}} and two days later, he joined [[Raptors 905]].{{cite web|title=2023-2024 Raptors 905 Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Raptors-905/41/Transaction_History/2024|website=RealGM.com|access-date=March 7, 2024}} ===Rio Grande Valley Vipers (2024–2025)=== On October 1, 2024, Nowell signed with the [[Houston Rockets]],{{cite web|first=Hiren|last=Joshi|title=Rockets Sign Two Players|url=https://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-sign-two-players-2|website=NBA.com|date=October 1, 2024|access-date=October 1, 2024}} but was waived on October 14.{{cite web|first=Luke|last=Adams|title=Rockets Waive Thon Maker, Markquis Nowell|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2024/10/rockets-signing-thon-maker-markquis-nowell-to-exhibit-10-deals.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=October 14, 2024|access-date=October 14, 2024}} On October 27, he joined the [[Rio Grande Valley Vipers]].{{cite web|title=Vipers Announce 2024-25 Training Camp Roster|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/vipers-announce-2024-25-training-camp-roster/n-6160244|website=OurSportsCentral.com|date=October 27, 2024|access-date=October 27, 2024}} ===Baskonia (2025–2026)=== On September 20, 2025, Nowell signed with [[Saski Baskonia|Baskonia]] of the Spanish [[Liga ACB]] and the [[EuroLeague]].{{cite web |title=Baskonia adds Nowell to their
